text:
maya: getting urgent alerts - scale-up lag in us-east-2 during a traffic spike, several jobs stuck Pending >7m, autoscaler attempted new nodes but they stayed in Provisioning.
trent: on it, grabbing provisioner logs
li: saw API 429s to cloud compute while spinning VMs, and some placement-group rejections
maya: logs show placement affinity failures + ipam errors
samir: can you paste the exact error? my hunch is IP allocation hitting a boundary in that node-subnet
maya: sure
```
provisioner-controller | ERROR allocating node: failed to attach to placement-group: region-az-b-placements status=REJECTED
cloud-ipam | ERROR allocateAddress: ENOSPC: available/private-ip range exhausted for subnet us-east-2b
autoscaler | INFO requested 12 nodes, created 0, pending_provision=12
```
trent: that's new - we hit a zone-local IPAM exhaustion while the autoscaler kept requesting nodes in the same AZ because of affinity rules.
li: the provisioner is honoring pod AZ affinity and placement groups, so it keeps retrying in the same AZ rather than falling back to other AZs.
infra-oncall: creating incident RT-7267, ops-bot will post updates
ops-bot: Incident RT-7267 created by infra-oncall - tags: autoscale, networking, us-east-2 - priority: P1
samir: quick mitigation: remove AZ affinity from the hot deployment so autoscaler can spread to neighbouring AZs, or create a temporary NodePool with relaxed affinity
maya: cost tradeoff - new nodepool will be expensive with on-demand fallback, but queues are backing up. I'm OK with temporary cost if it restores SLO
trent: I can spin a relaxed-pool with these commands
```
# create fallback pool
rci cloud compute nodepool create --region us-east-2 --az any --instance-type g5.xlarge --count 8 --label escaped-fallback
kubectl label nodepool escaped-fallback infra/fallback=hot
```
li: also opened a request to cloud to expand IPAM range for the subnet - that'll take longer but prevents recurrence
maya: applying the relaxed nodepool now
trent: deployed, autoscaler now sees capacity and pods are pulling images
maya: pods moving, backlog dropping :thumbsup:
samir: follow-up action items: (1) change default placement policy for critical hot paths to prefer AZ spread, (2) add IPAM headroom alert, (3) add autoscaler fallback policy to allow cross-AZ placement when placement-group rejections >=3
li: I'll file infra-ops ticket with cloud support and link RT-7267
infra-oncall: tagging eng-sre and product-impact, postmortem assigned to li
maya: thanks everyone - leaving a note in RT-7267: temporary fallback pool created, need cost amortization estimate
trent: cost estimate in the ticket shortly
maya: closing thread here, will update when cloud expands subnet or we deploy permanent fix
